payload.summary: Iteration 1 static/runtime differential found 25 material defects (6 P0, 14 P1, 5 P2/hypothesis) in Frank v0.1. The dominant defect is executable runtime lagging behind semantic contracts: continuity fallback creation, self-Harness authority ambiguity, revision/lease-unbound execution, stale capability resurrection, dependency-ignorant scheduling, silent sync failures, weak status parsing, non-atomic/stale projections, Graph-first recovery and schema-stack drift.
payload.hard_authority_rule: Frank may observe/diagnose/propose Harness changes but can never patch/migrate/promote/apply/delegate its own Harness change. All implementation work from this delta is executed under separate Research Entity authority. Frank-local work may only observe/test/receipt installed reality.
p0: P0-001 normal Frank boot can create new SQLite state when canonical DB is missing instead of CONTINUITY_DEGRADED
P0-002 frank.harness_evolution still contains Frank-owned promote/atomic_harness_cutover semantics
P0-003 execution receipts are not bound to work spec_rev/lease and can stale-complete revised work
P0-004 old capability events can be replayed and become freshly valid/current; no monotonic observation guard
P0-005 ChatGPT delegation receipt INSERT had 5 placeholders for 6 values; remote repo fix committed, local regression required
P0-006 snapshot recovery remains ClayGraph-first instead of UnifiedDB/epoch/transaction-first
p1_clusters: scheduler ignores declared dependencies/invalidators and real lease machinery
current spec can join old scheduler receipt
sync subprocess failures and timeout stacking are silently hidden
local possibility probe does not measure browser/connectors/GUI/file interchange despite semantic contract
remote work/capability projections lack atomic semantic epoch and durable freshness fields
status guard is substring-based, not exact-one structural parser; node freshness/glyph not validated; node id hardcoded
ChatGPT result ingest lacks strong request/result/authority binding
schema stacks differ between openers and state authority declaration is stale
replica cursor metadata is stale and current local ingestion of new Andreas project universe remains unverified
current smoke test expects result.counts not returned by self_test

branch_missions.harness: Own the executable differential; implement fail-closed continuity, authority guards, status parser, concurrency/lease/revision tests and target-machine fault injection.
branch_missions.unifieddb: Unify schema/migration manifest; make open-existing distinct from bootstrap; bind execution receipts to revision/lease; monotonic event/capability materialization; UnifiedDB-first snapshots/replay.
branch_missions.claygraph: Guarantee graph is rebuild-only derived state; epoch-pin projection/rebuild; identity contamination cannot reappear from old graph/snapshot; test graph parity after recovery.
branch_missions.claycode: Type ProposalOnly vs ResearchEntityEffect, WorkSpecRevision/Lease/ExecutionReceipt, CapabilityObservation valid-time and SemanticEpoch projection contracts so runtime cannot silently weaken semantics.
branch_missions.frank: Specify required self-observation/identity/possibility behavior and adversarial user-facing regressions; no Harness implementation authority.
branch_missions.hyperposition: Model conflicting/stale capability and identity alternatives without CURRENT collapse; test higher-order relation simplification where relevant.
branch_missions.gwt: Ensure high salience/ignition never mints Harness authority; expose degraded/contradictory state to selection instead of hiding it.
branch_missions.emergenz: Falsify whether learned control/salience can leak across authority or freshness boundaries; use lesion/rescue and replay adversaries.
branch_missions.clay: Coordinate cross-branch convergence, prevent local fixes from creating new semantic drift, and require a no-new-P0/P1 iteration before closure.

fixed_remote_repo_during_iteration: ChatGPT delegation receipt SQL placeholder mismatch
Andreas project-memory/browser work event payload normalized to actual runtime work_id/work_clay/completion_clay schema
payload.closure_rule: Not complete after patches. Repeat static differential -> executable regression -> adversarial fault injection -> restart/recovery -> concurrent nodes -> provider swap -> next bugsearch iteration. Stop only after a full iteration finds no new P0/P1 under equal or stronger tests.
